copy.captionKo: 뜨거운 첫 모금에 깜짝 놀라는 순간. 네이비 코트 안에서 코발트 니트가 선명하게 빛나요.
copy.captionEn: The first sip is hotter than expected. A cobalt knit shines inside a navy coat.
copy.captionDe: Der erste Schluck ist heißer als gedacht. Kobaltblauer Strick leuchtet im marineblauen Mantel.
copy.introKo: 코트와 바지는 네이비로 차분하게 맞추고, 색은 니트 하나에만 맡기세요. 굵은 코발트 터틀넥이 소매 끝까지 이어지면 어두운 저녁에도 얼굴과 손 주변이 밝아져요. 장갑은 끼지 않고 손에 쥐고만 있어도 룩의 일부가 됩니다.
copy.introEn: Keep coat and trousers in calm navy and give all the colour to the knit. When the chunky cobalt turtleneck shows right to the cuffs, it lights up the face and hands on a dark evening. Even held in one hand rather than worn, the gloves still belong to the look.
copy.introDe: Mantel und Hose bleiben ruhig in Marineblau, die ganze Farbe gehört dem Strick. Zeigt sich der grobe kobaltblaue Rollkragen bis zu den Bündchen, hellt er an einem dunklen Abend Gesicht und Hände auf. Selbst in der Hand gehalten statt getragen, gehören die Handschuhe zum Look.
copy.tipKo: 커피를 사며 장갑을 잠깐 벗을 땐 주머니보다 컵을 들지 않은 손에 쥐어 두세요. 다시 낄 때 찾을 일이 없어요.
copy.tipEn: When you take your gloves off for a coffee, keep them in your free hand rather than a pocket; they're right there when you want them back.
copy.tipDe: Zieht man für einen Kaffee die Handschuhe aus, behält man sie besser in der freien Hand als in der Tasche – so sind sie gleich wieder zur Hand.
copy.note: Written in Korean from the editorial (the delivery has English descriptions only, no Korean master), then localized to en/de.
